description: Use this when a developer asks about one specific sports odds or sports data API by name, for example "Is The-Odds-API free?", "Does OddsPapi have a WebSocket?", "OddsJam API pricing", or "Sportradar API review". Returns everything the SportsAPIs.dev review page records: feature support, pricing tiers from our review, free tier, sports mentioned, strengths, the full review text, FAQs, alternatives in the directory, and the review URL. The provider must be in the SportsAPIs.dev directory. Do not use this for a sportsbook, a league, or a betting question.

provider.description: Provider name or slug, for example "OddsPapi", "the odds api", "sportsdata-io".

name: get_sports_api_details

coverage.description: What the SportsAPIs.dev Coverage Map records for this provider, with the date we checked it. Null when the provider is not in the map.

group.description: "us", "offshore", "global", "uk-ireland", "europe", "australia-nz", "canada", "latam", "asia", "exchange", or null for a book our book list does not map yet.

finderUrl.description: The provider on the SportsAPIs.dev Coverage Map.

liveLeagues.description: Leagues with live odds. Empty means not checked yet, not none.

rawMarketCount.description: Markets the provider names that our market list does not map yet.

source.description: "probe" = checked with our own API key, "docs" = read from the provider docs, "manual" = reported by the provider.

verifiedLabel.description: The checked date as a phrase, for example "Verified 28 October 2026".

next_steps.description: Which tool to call for the likely follow-up questions.

title: Get the SportsAPIs.dev review of one provider
